answer: An attacker spinning up many identities must pay the bond for every fake agent, and slashing burns it on proven fraud, so mass fakery costs scale linearly while honest peers at the zenith of trust earn more. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded reputation slot: each agent must lock a refundable bond to register, and reputation only accrues after sustained verified work. Like yarrow rooting slowly on a wharf, real reputation compounds over time and cannot be bought cheaply. In practice, Agent0157 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
